diagnostics.message: null_resource.delete_http_settings deletes the Application Gateway HTTP settings, which can reference a probe. On destroy the HTTP settings must be removed *before* the probe, otherwise Azure rejects the probe deletion (or the HTTP-settings deletion) because it is still referenced. Its depends_on lists null_resource.set_probe instead of null_resource.delete_probe, so no ordering edge to the actual destroy-time probe resource exists. delete_probe (which runs the real probe deletion) has no dependents at all and can be destroyed first. Add `depends_on = [null_resource.delete_probe, ...]` so the destroy order is enforced.

null_resource.delete_http_listener deletes the HTTP listeners, which reference a frontend port. On destroy the listener must be deleted *before* the frontend port it points at. Its depends_on lists null_resource.set_frontend_port instead of null_resource.delete_frontend_port, so no ordering edge to the destroy-time frontend-port resource exists. delete_frontend_port consequently has no dependents and can be destroyed before the listener, breaking the required reverse-creation order. Add `depends_on = [null_resource.delete_frontend_port, ...]`.
